main.description: Creates an organization, whose handle is a scope on this registry, with the caller as its only owner. The registry writes its members record and its DID's genesis operation, with any 'recoveryKeys' ranked above the registry's rotation keys. Without recovery keys, the registry's are the DID's only rotation keys. The members record counts once the caller attests it.

name.description: The scope's name: the first label of the organization's handle.

recoveryKeys.description: Optional recovery keys, held by the owners, ranked first to last above the registry's rotation keys. At most two: the registry keeps three of a DID's five rotation keys, for its operator's two offline keys and its online one.

errors.name: NameTaken
errors.description: The scope exists, or the registry reserves its name.

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.description: The registry's rules do not let the caller create a scope: it lets only the accounts its admins list, or the scope needs the operator's approval or a claim on a domain.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The caller has created as many scopes as the registry allows.
